body:
This PR updates us to the new way of handling CLIMAParameters. In the new approach we get the parameters by creating a toml file with all the needed parameters. We later put them into parameters, microphysics_parameters and thermodynamics_parameters "boxes" our relevant modules. 

We need CLIMAParameters to get the default values in tests. 

I also moved `t1` and `w1` from a separate struct into parameters.

@edejong-caltech and @sajjadazimi - lmk if it makes sense. To me it's a little bit more convoluted than before, hence more boiler plate. But I think we should nevertheless move on and strive to be compatible with the newest versions of clima packages. Also, this will deal with all the PRs that compat was trying to have
title: Update to new clima parameters
